title: galium mollugo var. guillemotii
intro: Galium mollugo var. guillemotii, commonly known as Autumnal Bedstraw, is a perennial herb that belongs to the family Rubiaceae. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as reducing inflammation, improving digestive issues, and alleviating menstrual cramps. The therapeutic actions of Autumnal Bedstraw include its ability to act as a diuretic, astringent, and anti-inflammatory agent, making it a valuable remedy for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
